text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
On the day of the Asahi Hai F.S.,<n>Mejiro Ryan sits in
the stands with a<n>solemn look on her face. It seems
that her recent loss is still eating<n>away at her.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Racked with self-doubt, Mejiro Ryan<n>feels that her
performance was<n>unworthy of the Mejiro family
name,<n>but Mejiro Bright believes in her<n>potential.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
The Asahi Hai F.S. marks Ines<n>Fujin's first G1
race. Even though<n>the race is about to start, I can't
shake my concerns about the limited<n>prep time we
had.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Ines Fujin sees through my<n>awkward attempts to
compensate for<n>my concerns, but ends up easing
my<n>worries with some words of<n>encouragement of
her own. For now,<n>I have to trust in her strength!
